articles.title: 'Steps' Tells Cinderella From the Stepsisters' Side
articles.summary: Netflix's 'Steps' tells Cinderella from the stepsisters' side: funny and brightly colored, but with a crowded story, the review says.

articles.title: RAYE Leads the 2027 Grammy Names With 11
articles.summary: RAYE leads the 2027 Grammy nominations with 11, tying a record, while Rosalía follows with nine; the winners will be announced on February 7, 2027.

articles.title: This Drone Perches Like a Bird, Using Touch
articles.summary: A drone built at Delft University can feel its way onto a branch and hang there without using extra energy.
